faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about studying in Turkey

items.q: How much does it cost to study in Turkey?
items.a: Tuition fees in Turkey range from $3,000 to $15,000 per year depending on the university and program. Public universities are generally more affordable, while private universities may offer scholarships to reduce costs.

items.q: Can I study in English in Turkey?
items.a: Yes! Many top Turkish universities offer full English-medium programs, including Boğaziçi, METU, Koç, Sabancı, and Bilkent universities. Our consultants can help you find the right English-taught program.

items.q: What scholarships are available for international students?
items.a: Turkey offers excellent scholarships including the government-funded Türkiye Bursları (covers tuition + accommodation + stipend), and university-specific scholarships ranging from 25% to 100% tuition discounts.

items.q: How long does the application process take?
items.a: The application process typically takes 4-8 weeks. With Yildiz Foundation's guidance, we streamline the process and help you prepare all necessary documents efficiently.

items.q: Do I need to learn Turkish to study in Turkey?
items.a: Not necessarily. If you choose an English-medium program, you can study without knowing Turkish. However, learning basic Turkish will greatly enhance your daily life experience.

items.q: What is the student visa process for Turkey?
items.a: Once you receive your acceptance letter, you apply for a student visa at your nearest Turkish consulate. The process usually takes 2-4 weeks. Our team provides full support throughout the visa application.

sections.p: When you book a consultation, send a message or create an account, we collect the details you provide: name, email, phone number, country, study interests and budget.
We use your information only to answer your enquiries, arrange consultations, help with university applications and send you relevant updates about studying abroad.
We share your details with a university or partner only when needed to process your application and only with your knowledge. We never sell your personal data.
Your data is stored on secured servers with restricted access. Passwords are stored in hashed form and cannot be read by our staff.
You may ask us to access, correct or delete your personal data at any time by contacting us.
We use a small cookie to remember your language choice and to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising cookies.

Yildiz Foundation provides educational consultancy and admission support. We are not a university and do not guarantee admission, visas or scholarships, which are decided by the relevant institutions and authorities.
We work to keep university, program and fee information accurate, but it may change. Please confirm details with the university before applying or paying any fees.
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you submit and for keeping your login details confidential.
Any consultancy or service fees will be explained and agreed with you in advance. Tuition fees are paid to the university, not to this website.
You agree not to misuse the website, attempt to access it without permission or submit false information.
We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the website means you accept the updated terms.
